'''The Source''' is a prominent figure in the Scape and Run: Parasites [[Lore]]. 

==''Known Info''==
The Source is a gigantic eldritch entity found deep underground, although above Bedrock. It cannot be found nor does it have a physical form, at least for the time being.  

The Source is responsible for the presence of [[Buglin|Buglins]], as well as [[Beckon|Beckons]] and [[Deterrent Parasites]] in later phases. It exists as a direct consequence of [[Mobs|Parasites]] building it. It becomes "active" starting from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 3|Phase 3]], when the [[Reinforcement System]] becomes available.  

==''[[Previews]]''==
So far, the only public preview that mentioned the Source has depicted it as an upcoming [[Bosses|Boss]], with its own Boss Healthbar.
